name: Synology Photos
description: Show a Synology Photos album as your screensaver. Paste an album sharing link; no NAS account or album ID needed.
author: Peter Gerdes

settings.title: Album sharing link
settings.description: In Synology Photos, open the album, enable sharing for anyone with the link, then paste the full link here. Use an address reachable from the kiosk. Setup checks the album automatically.

settings.title: Album password (optional)
settings.description: Only the sharing-link password, never your NAS account password. Leave blank if the album has no password. SDK 1 stores and displays this as an ordinary text setting.

settings.title: Time per photo
settings.description: How long to show each photo while the screensaver is active.

settings.title: Shuffle photos
settings.description: Show every usable photo once per pass in random order. Turn off to use oldest-to-newest order.

settings.title: Photo layout
settings.description: Fit keeps the entire photo on a black background. Fill crops the edges to fill the available space.

settings.title: Check for album changes
settings.description: Refresh the photo list while this screensaver is active. Use Reconnect and refresh to check immediately.
